note: Every v2 execution of the harness on the frozen SPY inputs, in time order. The first seven entries were enumerated from the retained private output directories of the implementing session; each later entry was appended by the operator of its run. run.py copies this list into each new receipt under preconditions.prior_v2_replays; after a run, the operator appends that run here before the next one. Runs whose output directory was not retained cannot be enumerated from disk; none is known. The sealed probes under probes/v2 are preregistration evidence recorded in mapping-manifest-v2.json and are not listed here. Receipt hashes name private files that are not published. The first six replays listed are superseded, and none of them was reviewed before it ran. bwrap-cc4503f-qualifying ran after the review of cc4503f and is the qualifying replay; later entries are reproductions of the reviewed harness that cannot qualify. harness_local_source_sha256, where present, is the replay's reviewed-harness file set as run.py hashed it; compare.py fails a run whose reviewed files equal any listed replay's, and re-hashes this file at comparison time, accepting only an append-only extension of the list the run recorded.
